decision: Initialize the Sourcera application in this repository after the delivery control plane passes.
assumption: No separate application repository or deployable branch currently exists.
validationTrigger: A verified application repository or explicit repository-boundary decision appears.

decision: Use one active implementation lane with WIP limit 1.
assumption: Current human capacity supports one reviewed change at a time.
validationTrigger: Two completed reviewed batches establish throughput or another active delivery owner joins.

decision: Blake Rowley is the interim owner for all planned work and interim reviewer only for codex-ready batches.
assumption: No second active human member is available in the Linear workspace.
validationTrigger: A second active human member joins; owner and reviewer must then be separated.

decision: Live release scanners override copied or stale Master Spec header counts.
assumption: Volatile counts can change without a header rewrite.
validationTrigger: A deterministic generated-header mechanism replaces authored counts.

decision: Release assignments use source semantics, dependency closure, and explicit R0 critical-path overrides.
assumption: The current six-release model is the smallest reversible plan consistent with the stated customer journeys.
validationTrigger: A source change, customer pilot, or delivery-owner review disproves an assignment.

decision: Each runtime gate follows the named product behavior selected by source-section and assertion matching plus reviewed overrides.
assumption: The current feature inventory is the canonical behavior index for runtime proof routing.
validationTrigger: The feature inventory or a runtime assertion changes, or deployed evidence identifies a different owning behavior.
